text.body: || śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ || asyaśrīmallārīkavacamaṃtrasya | skaṃdaṛṣiḥ | śrīmalhārīdevatā | anuṣṭhupachaṃdaḥl śrīmallārīkavacajapeviniyogaḥll sanatkumāra uvāca | munīnāṃ saptakoṭīnāṃ | varadaṃ bhaktavatsalama | duṣṭa mardana deveśaṃ | vaṃdehaṃ mhālasāpatima || anugrahāya devānāṃ | maṇiratnagirausthitaṃ | prasannavadanaṃ nityaṃ | vaṃdehaṃ malla vairiṇaṃ || sarvadevamayaṃ śāṃta | kaumāraṃ karuṇākaraṃ | ādirudra mahārudra | vaṃdehaṃ savitvakapriyama || bhuktīmuktī pradaṃ devaṃ | sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ || koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ | vaṃdehaṃ asurāṃtakaṃ || ādidevaṃ mahādevaṃ | mallārī parameśvarama | vīrastvastyāvirupākṣaṃ | vaṃdehaṃ bhaktavatsalaṃ || bhogarūpaparaṃ jyotiḥ | śiromālā vibhūṣitaṃ | triśalādidharaṃ devaṃ | vaṃdehaṃ lokarakṣakaṃ || idaṃ paṭhati yo bhaktyā | mallārī pratikārakaṃ | bhaktānāṃ varadaṃ nityaṃ | praṇatosmimaheśvaraṃ || vane raṇe mahādurge | rājacaura bhayopyuta | śākinīḍākinībhūta | piśācoragarākṣasaḥl grahapiḍāsu rogeṣu | viṣasarpabhayeṣuca || sadā mallārīmallārī | mallārītikīrtanaṃ | saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ | tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || trikāletu paṭhe nityaṃ | viṣṇū lokaṃsa gacchaṃtī | dehāṃtetu taprāpnotī | sarva loke mahīyate || iti śrībrahmāṃḍapurāṇe | kṣetrakhaṃḍe mallārīmahātme |
